verdict.rationale: Datadog is a SaaS observability platform, so a local or dev instance for testing instrumentation and dashboards is a fair axis for this kind of product. The evidence pack documents no self-hosted, local, or emulated Datadog backend. A community user states that Datadog has no local option for verifying tracing and metrics before shipping.

support.subject: As a developer, I can spin up a local or dev instance of the platform to test instrumentation and dashboards
